source.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one candidate emoji reference for a high-five interaction study, square composition.
Scene: plain white background.
Subject: celebratory high five between two different people, showing only their two hands and short forearms. One forearm enters diagonally from bottom left; the other enters diagonally from bottom right. Their open palms strike together above center. Both wrists stay far apart, forming a wide V. Fingers fan upward; show four fingers and one thumb belonging coherently to each hand. Use a slight three-quarter view so both hands remain individually legible and the palm contact is clear. One hand warm golden yellow, the other slightly deeper amber.
Style: polished rounded 3D mobile emoji, soft clay-like material, simple smooth shading, crisp silhouette, generous white margins.
Constraints: exactly two hands, five digits on each, no fused or detached fingers, no clasping or interlocked fingers, no prayer pose, no face, no body, no lettering, no decorative burst, no watermark. One icon only, no sheet or panel grid.

review.notes: AI inspection: rear-hand fingers are obscured, so five digits on that hand cannot be verified. Not admitted to training.

Keep generous white space around the entire icon. One icon, no labels, no text, no burst.
